cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Acknowledge the Disrespect
cards.instruction: Make someone apologize for the disrespect to your position, not merely for what happened.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. You told the trainees their head trainer was an idiot. I want an apology.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. For undermining their head trainer. They still need to follow my instructions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll email them after tomorrow's drill.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Read it to them before the drill. My whistle isn't going to outrank 'idiot' on its own.

mechanism: A treats B apology as a pupil performance to be corrected into public restoration of the head-trainer role before the next drill.
confusable: Not merely seeking pity for failure: A requires repudiation of status-undermining words.
comparison: Title in private apology versus timing and audience of a public retraction.
seedUse: D51 trainer/failed drill/trainees/whistle retained; S05 training claim fits the actual corrective relationship.
